description.en: The driver channel ID. Invoke the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying results. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. You can obtain it by hovering your mouse over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to retrieve it.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. In the **Edge Instances** page of the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.  

You can also invoke the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. For Enterprise instances, you must pass this parameter.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page in the returned result. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

title.zh: 查询驱动下关联的子设备
title.en: Query the Sub-devices Associated with a Driver

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
